## Documented role

The [Governor General Order of Canada citation](../sources/2023-order-of-canada-paul-gauthier.qmd) (awarded 11 May 2023; invested 12 December 2024) calls him “Initiator of British Columbia’s Choice in Supports for Independent Living” and co-founder of the Individualized Funding Resource Centre Society. That is an official honour citation. It is **not** a ministry design file, and it does not date CSIL.

No 1993–95 Ministry of Health document in this catalogue that we have read names him.

This archive does **not** infer formal CSIL design-group membership from the honour citation or from later founder language.

## Later accounts

Later Individualized Funding Resource Centre (IFRC) materials attributed to Gauthier, or describing him, disagree on the start year and use founder language:

- [2014 SCI slides](../sources/2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd): CSIL “established” in **1993**; “The Pilot — 50 people tried it out”; Gauthier labelled “Founder of CSIL”; “Pre CSIL?” list includes ECPM.
- [2015 Module 1](../sources/2015-gauthier-csil-module-1.qmd): the same “established” sentence with **1994**; labelled “the founder of the CSIL program.”
- [IFRC Our Team](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd): “one of the founders”; “started on the CSIL program in 1994.”

Those are later attributions, not 1990s records we have read. The 1993/1994 conflict is preserved on the [CSIL design and pilot chapter](../history/csil-pilot.qmd). ECPM naming in the 2014 deck is a later account, not a document that proves official succession ([ECPM chapter](../history/ecpm.qmd)).

## Unresolved

- What “initiator” / “founder” refers to in 1993–95 files from the time (design, advocacy, pilot participation, or later summary).
- How his role relates to [Joseph Theriault](joseph-theriault.qmd) and ECPM as described on the IFRC page.
- Whether he appears on the unread 1990 ECPM manual title page (not inferred).
